query: SELECT ua.id, ua.actionType, ua.feature, ua.imageUrl, ua.description, ua.createdAt, au.name FROM user_actions ua LEFT JOIN app_users au ON ua.appUserId = au.id WHERE ua.createdAt >= '2026-03-29 08:10:00' AND ua.createdAt <= '2026-03-29 08:20:00' ORDER BY ua.createdAt DESC LIMIT 20;
